angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 913,941 km at 113.52 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.8091 +/- 0.0094 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 113.52 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.3137 +/- 0.0251 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1751 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 913,941 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.9382 +/- 0.0363 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1751 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5970 +/- 86 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1751 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1751 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1751.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.173, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 146757: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1751 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.373 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1751 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.29732, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1751 (pscomppars): age 9 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1751 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.27 km/s, from Desai et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..194D/abstract)
